resources.string:
Camera Footage Area
 This is the live display from your mobile device's camera. It's always on, actively scanning the road for traffic signs.


Bounding Boxes and Labels
 When the app recognizes a traffic sign, it draws a bounding box around the sign within the camera footage area. Each bounding box is paired with a label indicating its type. These visual cues help you identify and understand the traffic signs detected by the app in real-time.


Top Three Recognized Traffic Signs
 On the left side of the screen, the app displays the top three detected traffic signs along with a label indicating its type. This lets you quickly glance at the type of sign recognized without looking away from the road.


Inference Time
 Found at the top-left corner of the screen. The app's response time, indicated by the inference time in milliseconds, shows the speed at which the app is processing and recognizing the traffic signs.

 Included Traffic Signs:

 Keep right — Keep Right
 Keep left — Keep Left
 No left turn — No Left Turn
 No right turn — No Right Turn
 No U-turn — No U-Turn
